heading: Three pilot interventions
intro: What young people designed and tested at the Museum of Modern Egyptian Art.
exploria_card: Documents and updates the museum’s labels: researched, fact-checked information, reached through a QR code beside each work.
exploria_intro: A team researching artists and an art movement in the collection to verify, correct and enrich the information shown at the museum. Each label gets a QR code that opens that artist’s page here.
guzur_card: Three routes through the museum, each with a map, narration and text for every artwork.
guzur_intro: Choose a route, follow the points on the floor plan, and listen and read as you look at each work.
robit_card: A mentor–student platform where the museum connects young people with the skills the art scene asks for.
robit_intro: The museum as a connector: mentors share the skills young people need to join the art scene, and students find a mentor.
